ctx.x: No, not any more. I got another guitar from home, and I stayed in Pittsburgh because I wanted to stay with the man. It wasn't easy, you know, but I used to go to a club called Crawford's Grill and they had a very good band there, and they had a drummer there that fascinated me. They called him Honey Boy. Honey Boy would play these drums, he was a wizard, and he had emery wheels on the end of his sticks, and somehow he worked these emery wheels and the fire would come out of the sticks, you know. And I would go --…
